title: Practice 7: The present for the future, and «let's go»

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (полететь — to fly off) в Тай в этом году.
exercises.why: **полетим** — future tense (1st person plural) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».
exercises.prompt: This year, we'll be flying to Thailand.

exercises.q: Расправь крылья и ___ (лететь — to fly, one way).
exercises.why: **лети** — imperative (ты, singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Spread your wings and fly away.

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) сюда немедленно.
exercises.why: **идите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) всё время прямо.
exercises.why: **идите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) лучше оденьтесь.
exercises.why: **идите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Почему мы ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) посюда?
exercises.why: **идём** — present tense (1st person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Why are we going this way?

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) приготовь попкорн.
exercises.why: **иди** — imperative (ты, singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) прямо через сквер.
exercises.why: **идите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
